entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?

Hi, Sarah. I... I hope you can help. I bought a helmet a little over a month ago, and I just... I really need to return it. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for a long time, and I'm just in a bind and could really use the money back.

I'm sorry to hear you're in a difficult situation. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To start, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, there's nothing wrong with it, I'm sure. In fact, the box is still unopened. It was really about the color; it just wasn't what I expected when it arrived. I was so excited about the top-tier safety rating, but now I just feel guilty every time I see it sitting there. I really should have been more careful with my money.
I understand completely. It's important that you're happy with your gear. Let me just pull up your order details and check the policy. Can you confirm the order number for me?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. I just feel so bad about this.
Thank you. Please hold one moment... Okay, I see the order. It looks like you received the helmet 39 days ago. Let me check the policy here... and... yes, you're in luck.
Really? Oh, that would be such a relief.

Yes. Our policy allows for returns on standard items for up to 90 days after delivery, as long as they are in their original condition. Since the box is unopened, you are well within that window. I can approve this return for you right now.
Oh, thank you! Thank you so much, Sarah. You have no idea how much I appreciate this. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it.

It's my pleasure to help. I've just initiated the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file. Just attach that to the package and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be issued.
That's wonderful. You've really made my day. Thank you again!
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. Have a great day!
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
